target: Supabase live project; disposable fictional demo records only

tests.name: Anonymous cannot read customer records or invoke staff commands
Required inputs and real phone numbers are rejected for demo
Manual add persists and retries return exactly one opportunity
Other tenant cannot read, mutate or directly insert into demo records
Worker can save job notes; concurrent stale edits fail
Returning customer needs confirmation and keeps distinct jobs
Remote quoting without a date creates no fake appointment
Quote pending decision can be recorded without scheduling work
Work requires explicit approval, amount, description and date
Approved work advances and creates one linked event
Customer and event rescheduling update the same event both directions
Lost/recover retains notes, exact previous stage and canceled appointments
Repeated Lost episodes are retained and appointments explicitly reactivate
Actual completion advances to Review and completes the Work event
Review draft is not a send; explicit skip reaches Done
Archive/restore preserves notes, customer and completed lifetime values
Owner-only settings/export and tenant-safe restore
Public intake cannot be invoked anonymously; server intake is idempotent
Invalid local dates and DST gaps/ambiguities are rejected
Manual events edit, complete, and delete independently
